root_idea.summary: The root expresses gathering or concentration together and resorting to a place of refuge.
root_idea.development: Its lexical orientation joins the ideas of coming together and seeking refuge; the noun مَوْئِل denotes a place of refuge or resort.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The form is Quran-attested and is retained as a public nominal form, but no numbered Quranic sense is asserted without qualifying direct Quran-focused evidence from Lane or Mufradat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of refuge or resort; a place to which one withdraws for protection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical nominal usage. The supplied lexical evidence establishes this meaning generally, without independently establishing a numbered Quranic sense in this packet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: First or former, preceding all others or preceding another; also the first part or beginning, the first comers, people of former ages, or an earlier year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes related plural and substantival uses such as أَوَائِلُ, “first parts” or “beginnings,” أَوَّلُونَ, “people of former ages,” and expressions referring to a former year.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only cross-reference to another article; no lexical definition is supplied in this unit.
The unit states the first/former semantic branch.
The Quranic expression is a beginning/first-part use of the same branch.
The expression denotes those who came first.
Former-age people belong to the same first/former branch.
The temporal expression denotes an earlier or former year.

cautions: The sole Quran occurrence of مَوْئِلًا is contextually glossed as “an escape,” but the supplied Quran Foundation gloss is contextual evidence only.
No unique Mufradat entry or direct Lane semantic exposition for the Quranic occurrence of مَوْئِل is supplied.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The Quranic occurrence at 18:58:19 is contextually rendered “an escape,” and Maqayis defines مَوْئِل as a place of refuge, but the packet does not supply the required direct Lane or unique Mufradat evidence to assign this interpretation as a numbered Quranic sense.
